This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the parties have reported a settlement in MC.No.6164/2022 in terms of which, the criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioner is permitted to be terminated.

In that view of the matter, the petition is allowed and the prosecution of the petitioners in CC.No.6909/2020 pending trial before IV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore City for the offences punishable under Section 498A read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, is hereby quashed.
